data.title: D · 假面华筵的暗线华尔兹
data.description: 璀璨水晶吊灯下的盛大舞池，身穿露背黑丝缎晚礼裙的D与你在乐声中旋转起舞。她一手搭在你的肩头，将脸颊凑近耳畔假借汇报搜查动向，眼中却闪烁着真切的深情。
data.location: luxurious crystal ballroom filled with dancing couples
data.action: waltzing closely across grand ballroom floor, resting hand on partner shoulder, whispering covert mission secrets while eyes shimmer with genuine romance
data.lighting: spectacular golden chandelier bokeh and opulent velvet ballroom ambiance
data.mood: covert thrill, aristocratic elegance, secret lovers intimacy
data.promptProse: Waltzing closely across a grand chandelier-lit ballroom in a black backless gown, D whispers secrets with glistening devoted purple eyes.
